title: Production hardening for Kanbus orchestration
description:
Harden the Rust-first orchestration implementation so AI-agent workers can run safely against production branches without relying on trial-only assumptions.

Definition of Done:
- Dangerous publish/workspace states fail closed with clear errors.
- Run lifecycle state is recoverable and auditable.
- Behavior is specified outside-in before implementation.
- Rust and relevant shared gates pass locally and in CI before any PR is considered.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Superseded by Python-first control-plane direction. Orchestration feature development should not be implemented as Rust binary logic inside kbs; continue via kbs-03f328 and related stories.
